__name: Market sell rates (RealMarketEvent) and buy rates (RealMarketEvent2)
__help: A value left out (or a broken file): the default of the mod.
Rates in % of the item value: the sell rate moves between MinSellRate and MaxSellRate, the buy rate between MinBuyRate and MaxBuyRate.
TownGReduceBuyRate / TownMReduceBuyRate: buy rate change (%) for the town guardian / the town master.
Events: market events. Start (month 1-12), Dur (months), Period (months between two); AddSellRate, AddBuyRate (%) while it runs. {} = no event; the list given replaces the default one.
